objective: Prove R89 dispatch and compare per-request raw GDN core/z outputs between c1 and c2 before the norm and output projection.

decision: If c2 records request-isolated dispatch and layer-0 core/z for cache-c000 match c1 on both ranks, localize the next difference to norm/output projection. If dispatch is packed, repair the R89 guard. If isolated dispatch runs but core/z differ, inspect native one-request metadata parity.
